title: DVA-C03: one request's path, hop by hop

steps.title: The user signs in
steps.note: Cognito user pool for sign-in and JWTs; identity pool for temporary AWS credentials

steps.title: API Gateway
steps.note: REST vs HTTP APIs; Cognito, Lambda or IAM authorizers; read 429, 502 and 504

steps.title: The function runs
steps.note: Memory, timeout, reserved vs provisioned concurrency; VPC access via NAT or endpoints

steps.title: Data is read and written
steps.note: DynamoDB keys for your queries, Query not Scan, GSI vs LSI; DAX or ElastiCache

steps.title: Slow work goes asynchronous
steps.note: SQS visibility timeout and DLQ, SNS fan-out, EventBridge routing; idempotent consumers

steps.title: Something breaks
steps.note: CloudWatch Logs for what one function did; X-Ray for which hop failed or was slow

caption: The request path this guide follows. Hops 6 (secrets) and 7 (shipping the code) have their own sections, so card 6 here is hop 8, "something breaks".
